questions.question: Which malignancies are associated with the following organisms?
questions.question_raw: Which malignancies are associated with the following organisms:
questions.model_answer:
a) Hepatitis C virus - hepatocellular carcinoma (also non-Hodgkin lymphoma).
b) HPV - cervical, vulvar, vaginal, penile, anal and oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
c) Schistosoma haematobium - squamous cell carcinoma of the bladder.
d) Clonorchis sinensis - cholangiocarcinoma.
e) Helicobacter pylori - gastric adenocarcinoma and gastric MALT lymphoma.
f) HHV-8 - Kaposi sarcoma (also primary effusion lymphoma, multicentric Castleman disease).
questions.beyond_mandell: Only the HPV association is in this chapter; HCV, S. haematobium, Clonorchis, H. pylori and HHV-8 associations are established knowledge from other chapters/IARC.
